# R4.5 — C12 polyglot measurement sheet (DF-S0.3-2 / M-S2-5, M-S2-3)

**Date:** 2026-10-21 (all stamps `date -u`) · **Ticket:** R4.5
(`docs/tickets/154_R4.5__c12-polyglot-ci-measurement.md`) · **Branch:**
`svitali/harnessharness-r4.5` · **Scope:** the two C12 conjuncts S0.3
deferred — two-toolchain clean build+test CI (M-S2-5) and far-side
canonical-parse+hash-verify at 16/64 KiB (M-S2-3) — plus the committed

they support no claim outside this matrix. Evidence, never gates.

## Method

- **E1-alone clean build+test:** `cargo clean` (removed 1,459,551
  files / 131.2 GiB — this worktree's full target dir), then timed
  `cargo build --workspace --all-targets` and timed
  `cargo test --workspace`. N = 1 (each run is a full clean build; the
  spread is carried by the foreign legs, N = 5 each).
- **Foreign legs (N = 5 each):** the E2/E3 answers were *regenerated
  from the trees at run time* — `python3 foreign/e2-python/foreign.py`
  and `node foreign/e3-typescript/foreign.ts` over the committed
  `crates/hh-xcheck/fixtures/cross-impl` bundle — each run followed by
  `hh-xcheck verify`. The far-side timing members (`parse_ns`,
  `rehash_ns`) are the arms' own recorded values — carried, never
  gated (`check.rs::is_informational` leaves them out of the verdict
  comparison).
- **Two-toolchain CI time (M-S2-5):** the CI leg rides the existing
  `build-test-drift` job — the polyglot increment over an E1-only run is
  the foreign leg's serial cost (both foreign toolchains are
  preinstalled on `ubuntu-latest`; there is no second compile
  toolchain — the E2/E3 trees are interpreter trees, "build" *is* the
  replay leg). So `T(pair) = T(E1) + T(leg)`, reported as the ratio
  against T(E1).

## Numbers

### M-S2-5 — clean build + test

| leg | wall (s) | total (min) | vs E1-alone |
|---|---|---|---|
| E1 build (`--workspace --all-targets`) | 127.035 | — | — |
| E1 test (`--workspace`, **3534 passed / 0 failed**) | 330.427 | — | — |
| **E1-alone total** | **457.462** | **7.62** | 1.0000× |
| E2 leg (median, N=5): gen 0.227 + verify 0.048 | 0.275 | — | — |
| E3 leg (median, N=5): gen 1.201 + verify 0.034 | 1.235 | — | — |
| **E1+E2** | 457.737 | 7.63 | **1.0006×** |
| **E1+E3** | 458.697 | 7.65 | **1.0027×** |
| E1+E2+E3 (the committed CI leg, both) | 458.972 | 7.65 | **1.0033×** |

Leg wall spread (s): E2 gen 0.083–0.416, verify 0.030–0.166; E3 gen
0.567–1.400, verify 0.028–0.134. `hh-xcheck verify` exits 1 on the E2
answers by design — the 8 cells the six-arm e2 tree does not answer
(`hir-documents` ×5 + `ledger-scenarios` ×3) fail `missing answer` as
the recorded pending cells; `xcheck-foreign.sh` classifies them
honestly (covered-arm failures 0, pending 8). E3 verifies 57/0.

**Score-5 bound (CI ≤ 1.5× single-toolchain): met** — worst pair
1.0027× ≪ 1.5×.

### M-S2-3 — far-side canonical-parse + hash-verify (µs/frame, median of N=5)

| frame | E2 parse | E2 rehash | E3 parse | E3 rehash |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 KiB (4 frames) | 112.9–172.9 | 562.8–2308.6 | 75.0–99.3 | 3799.6–7820.8 |
| 64 KiB (2 frames) | 297.0–430.7 | 3123.0–3512.0 | 229.9–314.8 | 11449.8–21858.7 |
| arm total (6 frames) | 1207.9 | 10789.4 | 1570.8 | 111762.0 |

Spread: E2 parse ≤ 2.37 ms max, rehash ≤ 61.6 ms max (one outlier);
E3 parse ≤ 4.94 ms max, rehash ≤ 94.0 ms max. Per-frame far-side
canonical-parse+hash-verify stays in the **10²–10⁴ µs** band on both
foreign toolchains at both sizes — ~10.8–111.8 ms for the whole
six-frame arm.

### M-S2-7 — hash-equality across the boundary

`hh-xcheck verify`: **E3 57/57 (100 %)**, E2 49/49 covered (100 % — the
8 unanswered extension-arm cells are `missing answer` pending cells,
not mismatches). E1 selfcheck 97/0. No divergence.

## Re-derived C12 (l1-spike-spec §5 thresholds)

| conjunct | bound (score 5) | measured | met? |
|---|---|---|---|
| per-run overhead | ≤ 2 % | 0.056 % (S0.3) | yes |
| codegen round-trip | ≤ 10 min | 26 ms (S0.3) | yes |
| two-toolchain CI | ≤ 1.5× | 1.0006× (E1+E2) / 1.0027× (E1+E3) | yes |
| M-S2-7 hash-equality | 100 % | 100 % | yes |

**Measured C12 (E5a) = 5** vs the ADR-0050 §3 assumed **2** → |Δ| = 3,
**outside the ±1 band** — favorable direction: the assumed penalty
overstated the polyglot cost (the measured pairs carry ~0.3 % added CI
time and far-side serialization at the µs/frame scale). For the
E5b/E5c splits (assumed 3): the transport half was measured favorable
at S0.3b (per-run overhead 1.60 %/4.46 %, hash-equality 100 %); their
kernel-side CI pairs (E3-kernel+E2-lab, E2-kernel+E3-surface) are not
buildable in this tree — candidate ids only (CC4), recorded honestly
rather than extrapolated.

## Trigger-5 disposition (ADR-0050 §6)

Trigger 5's condition — a candidate's measured C12 outside the assumed
±1 — **fires for the winning candidate E5a (2 → 5, favorable)**. The
steps-5–7 substitution with weights frozen: raising the winner's C12 by
+3 on a 9.18-weight criterion strictly strengthens E5a; no losing
candidate's score moves, and ADR-0050 §4's kernel-family robustness
(E1 kernel: 0.979 of corners, survives every adversarial sweep) is
untouched. **Verdict stated from the numbers: the decision HOLDS** —
the measured re-confirmation ADR-0050's amendment log records. This
also retires the `unmeasured-by-spike` `u` mark on C12's polyglot
conjunct: the components the assumed-2 penalty was *about* are now
measured.
